title: Pathing Plus
description:
Pathing Plus is designed to help you draw better paths (and hopefully make
better pathing decisions as a result).

Features include:

- Use the draw and eraser tools to map out your path - straight lines snap to the path you draw.
- Alternate map views - fit the entire map on screen vertically or horizontally.
- Automatic route analysis: how many elites / fires / events are there on each path?
- Improved gamepad support for the map features (left analog button to switch between draw and eraser tools, right trigger to switch between map views)

Feedback and feature requests always welcome!

Source code and issue tracker:
https://github.com/davekalina/spire2-pathing-plus
changeNote:
- The right stick scrolls the map, the way it did in the first game. The left stick and d-pad stay on selection.
- New Auto-Path menu on the toolbar: pick Max Elites, Fires, Shops, Events or Combats and the map is redrawn with the routes that collect the most of it.
- The toolbar is reachable with a gamepad. Press up from the top of the Legend, and pressing a button there no longer throws you back to the map.
- The left stick steers the quill after picking it up with the mouse.
- Path Mode is gone. Drawing is simply how it works, with an Override Drawing Controls setting for anyone who wants the map's own scribbling back.
- Hovering a route deepens its colour instead of turning it black, and one with no column gets an unheaded one at the end of the Legend.
